title.en: Henkyo Mob Kizoku no Uchi ni Totsuidekita Akuyaku Reijo ga, Mechakucha Dekiru Yoi Yome nanda ga?

altTitles.ja: 辺境モブ貴族のウチに嫁いできた悪役令嬢が、めちゃくちゃできる良い嫁なんだが？

altTitles.en: The Evil Noblewoman Turned Out to Be the Perfect Wife
The Villainess Who Came to Marry Into the Frontier Noble's Household Is an Exceptionally Capable Wife, Isn't She?

description.en:
Ragna, heir to a noble family on the kingdom’s outskirts, wasn’t just any young man—
he was a Japanese office worker who had been reincarnated into a strange yet familiar world: the setting of an otome game he once knew in his previous life.

All he ever wanted was a quiet, simple life…
but reality had other plans.

His days became filled with harsh duties managing the rough frontier lands, each day bringing new challenges.

Amidst the chaos, he suddenly finds himself forced into a political marriage with a high-ranking noblewoman named Alicia—
who just so happens to be the main villainess of the otome game!

But something’s off…
Alicia’s behavior doesn’t resemble a villainess at all.
In fact, her reputation seems to be nothing more than a byproduct of the game’s scripted plot and rigid narrative.

Now, Ragna faces a daunting mission:
How can he save his wife from the tragic fate that awaits her in the original game?
And can he rewrite the story…
to craft a happy ending of his own?
